RaceName: Happy 100th Birthday Chepstow Racecourse "Training Series" Apprentice Handicap (RE Series)

RaceName: Happy 100th Birthday Chepstow Racecourse "Training Series" Apprentice Handicap (RE Series)
Spotlight: Always prominent when belatedly off the mark over C&D in June and probably performed to a similar level when beaten 2l off this figure at Leicester; after steering clear of 6f for so much of her career, it's now looking a good fit.

RaceName: Happy 100th Birthday Chepstow Racecourse "Training Series" Apprentice Handicap (RE Series)
Spotlight: 0-14 but has competitive form off higher marks and was runner-up over 5f here two weeks ago; won't be hindered by returning to 6f and blinkers might give him a lift.

RaceName: Happy 100th Birthday Chepstow Racecourse "Training Series" Apprentice Handicap (RE Series)

RaceName: Guidenstown Stud Irish EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Siyouni colt; second foal; half-brother to 1m/1m1f winner Green Impact (inc 2yo Group 2; RPR 114); dam runner-up 1m2f/13.5f (70), half-sister to winners Alphabet (Group-placed 6f) and Aerion Power (useful 7f/1m), out of half-sister to Irish 2,000 Guineas winner Power; check market.

RaceName: Guidenstown Stud Irish EBF Maiden

RaceName: Guidenstown Stud Irish EBF Maiden

RaceName: Loros - Irish EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

RaceName: Loros - Irish EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 65,000euros yearling; ninth foal; half-brother to winners Corazon (5f 2yo including Group 3), Savvy Disko (1m/1m1f; RPR 95), She Can Boogie (5f including 2yo; 94), Twafeeg (6.5f 2yo; 87) and Happy Tears (6f AW; 81); dam 5f 2yo winner (91); likely to improve for this first run but bred to be a talented 2yo and yard did have a 2yo newcomer win at 12-1 at Salisbury in June.

RaceName: Loros - Irish EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

RaceName: Randox Rated Hurdle

RaceName: Randox Rated Hurdle
Spotlight: Dual hurdle winner at Clonmel (2m4f/2m6f) is yet to score over fences but has posted several solid runs in defeat; two recent Wexford efforts were well below best, however, and now reverts to hurdles with blinkers tried.

RaceName: Randox Rated Hurdle
Spotlight: C&D maiden winner two years ago for this trainer; has had just two outings since, latest when pulled up after losing touch three out in 2m Kilbeggan handicap won by Malbay Madness in May; hard to fancy.

RaceName: Randox Rated Hurdle
Spotlight: Dual 1m AW winner for former yard and went close on yard debut at Dundalk in November; modest enough form in four attempts hurdling, most recently poor Flat effort at Galway last month; seemingly lots to find.

RaceName: Coral Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Five-race maiden who is moving gradually in the right direction; good second at Thirsk (6f, good to firm; nursery debut) most recently; possibilities provided she copes with the drop in distance.

RaceName: Coral Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Thrice-raced filly who posted clear best effort, namely 50-1 second at Ffos Las, in sole attempt over 5f and only start in cheekpieces; could go well with those two factors back in play.

RaceName: Coral Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Has started at 28-1 in his novice races, best effort when fifth over C&D; ties in with Chianti on that form and goes handicapping with a more realistic chance than previously; one to bear in mind.

Spotlight: Best known for AW exploits, but is effective on turf; not a bad effort on seasonal return in the Habitat Handicap when 2.25l behind the winner Headmaster (6f, good); good second at Navan next time, but his latest two runs have been below-par, including when well beaten over 6.5f here last time; blinkers return and replace the visor worn that day.

RaceName: Sheehy Motors Volkswagen Handicap
Spotlight: Four-time winner was only beaten a short head by Ipanema Queen at Cork last time (5f, good to firm); nudged up 1lb but more concerning is that his runs at this track this term have been moderate; capable if things fall right though.

RaceName: Sheehy Motors Volkswagen Handicap
OwnerName: Mary B Hogan & Michael M O'Brien
Spotlight: Has been in career-best form this season, winning back-to-back handicaps over 5f at Cork (good) and Down Royal (soft) before just failing to catch Genesis in the Rockingham Handicap over C&D in June; returned to handicap company at Cork last time when a creditable fifth (1.75l behind the winner Ipanema Queen); claimer is yet to win from 15 starts.

RaceName: Sheehy Motors Volkswagen Handicap
Spotlight: Added to two British 7f wins when bagging the Habitat Handicap (6f, good) here in May on second start for new yard; another solid display over 7f at Cork next time; never got involved after slipping coming out of the gates in the Scurry Handicap last time (6.5f, good to firm); firmly in the mix but not certain to appreciate this first try at the minimum trip.

RaceName: Sheehy Motors Volkswagen Handicap
OwnerName: Stonestreet Stables, LLC & AMO Racing Limited
Spotlight: Dual Listed winner over 5f last year (including C&D); found life tougher this term but found the winners' enclosure once again in a Cork premier handicap (5f, good to firm) last time when prevailing by a short head back to Erosandpsyche; in the mix again off 3lb higher.

RaceName: Sheehy Motors Volkswagen Handicap
Spotlight: Made all to win a small-field Listed event at Tipperary last July (5f, good); two defeats afterwards came over 6f in Group 3 company; made seasonal return in a Listed race at Bath in April (5f, good) but was well beaten; makes handicap debut now and rider's 7lb claim is a help.

RaceName: Sheehy Motors Volkswagen Handicap
Spotlight: Scored for the third time when taking a Bellewstown handicap off 89 early last month (5f, good); solid efforts at Dundalk and Cork (5f, good to firm) since; just 1.25l behind Ipanema Queen latest; front runner is down 1lb and could go well.

RaceName: Sheehy Motors Volkswagen Handicap
OwnerName: Samuel M Mencoff & Anthony Paul Smurfit
Spotlight: Maiden winner over 6f last year had been running mostly in stakes company until making his handicap debut at Cork last time (5f, good to firm) when eighth of 11 and behind a few of these; dropped 3lb but more needed.

RaceName: Sheehy Motors Volkswagen Handicap
Spotlight: Has been in the form of his life this season; won over 6f here on seasonal return and bagged another victory in a C&D premier handicap in June despite being 3lb out of the weights; didn't quite see out the 6.5f trip of the Scurry handicap here last month, but it was still a blinding run to finish third; went too quick at Cork last time; definite chance.

RaceName: Sheehy Motors Volkswagen Handicap
OwnerName: J Kirkland & Mrs J M Ryan
Spotlight: Thrived since joining this yard, three wins over 5f from six starts at Dundalk; progress stalled upped to 6f last time when last of ten; that run was too bad to be true and given a break since but she's up 29lb since her first win and needs to prove herself on turf now.

RaceName: Sheehy Motors Volkswagen Handicap
Spotlight: Admirable sort with seven wins and 17 places to his name; struggled in two turf starts in the first half of June following a Dundalk win; outran his 33-1 odds when fourth behind Genesis over C&D latest.

RaceName: Sheehy Motors Volkswagen Handicap
Spotlight: Made a low-key debut over 6.5f here but improved plenty to take the third spot at Cork next time (5f, good, 40-1); better again at 6f back at Cork (good to firm) last time when prevailing by 1l; her opening mark doesn't look too bad and she could play a role if her improvement continues.

RaceName: Sheehy Motors Volkswagen Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark at the sixth attempt when scoring in a Bellewstown maiden (5f, good) last month; faded into seventh over C&D next time (good to firm) but didn't run too badly in a Naas Listed contest four days later (6f, good); second of five in a 6f Naas conditions race last time; drop back to 5f should suit but 2lb wrong.

RaceName: Catalogue Engineering Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Encouraging third on debut at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) in June and close second at Ayr (7f, good to firm) since; the Ayr winner followed up in a nursery, suggesting this fellow could be on a good mark on handicap debut.

RaceName: Catalogue Engineering Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: She's improved with each of her three runs, going close at Newbury (6f, good to firm) on second start then winning at Lingfield (7f, AW); could continue to progress and she's one to consider.

RaceName: Catalogue Engineering Nursery Handicap
OwnerName: Middleham Park Racing Civ & B R Millman
Spotlight: Won at Beverley (5f, good to soft) in April on the second of her five starts and ran well when third at Kempton (7f, AW) last month on her nursery debut, coming from further back than the first two; could have more to offer.

RaceName: Catalogue Engineering Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: He's raced four times and, after being gelded, he achieved his best result when fourth of sixth at Chester (7f, good) a fortnight ago; has more realistic claims in this first nursery but not obviously well treated.

RaceName: Catalogue Engineering Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Yet to threaten but showed ability when third in C&D maiden (good) in June and also when near-8l second at Brighton (7f, good to firm) last month; the form of his course run suggests he may have potential off his opening mark and he could have a part to play.

RaceName: Catalogue Engineering Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Kept on for 2l third of seven on nursery debut at Chepstow (6f, good to firm) last month and ran okay when fourth of ten at Ffos Las (7.3f, good) recently; however, he was no match for the first three last time; needs to find something extra and he could do with breaking better.

RaceName: Prix Daphnis - Jockey Club Argentino (Arg) (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Posted a career best winning the 7f Group 3 Prix de la Porte Maillot on good ground (Alexis Pouchin rode for the first time) 52 days ago, with Synaran fourth, having been down the field in the Poule d'Essai Des Poulain prior to that; stepping back up to a mile holds no fears and already proven at the level, so holds place chances at least.

RaceName: Prix Daphnis - Jockey Club Argentino (Arg) (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Beat Synaran on his racecourse debut and won the Group 3 Prix la Force at Longchamp (1m1f, good to soft) in this year, but was then comfortably held in both the Poule d'Essai Des Poulains and Prix du Jockey Club; dropping in grade plus trip should help, and Pierre-Charles Boudot rides for first time.

RaceName: Prix Daphnis - Jockey Club Argentino (Arg) (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Steadily progressing throughout his career, and won the Group 3 Prix de Fontainebleau at Longhchamp (1m, good) in April prior to claiming second in the Poule d'Essai Des Poulains (French 2,000 Guineas); not too far below that level when down the field in the Prix du Jockey Club when last seen, and drop in trip and grade should be a positive; Augustin Madamet rides him for the first time.

RaceName: Prix Daphnis - Jockey Club Argentino (Arg) (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Won an Italian Group 3 over a mile in May, the Premio Parioli (Italian 2000 Guineas), and then went on to run to the same level  twice in a row when upped in distance, which included a neck second in the Derby Italiano (1m3f, heavy); coming back down in trip shouldn't be a worry and Maxime Guyon an interesting jockey booking.

RaceName: Prix Daphnis - Jockey Club Argentino (Arg) (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Useful as a 2yo but improved for a gelding operation during the winter, posting consistent figures and beating Kozlovskha in a Listed race at Longhamp in April when giving that colt weight; that rival gained his revenge in the Group 3 Prix de la Porte Maillot last time off levels, but the son of Mehmas didn't have a completely clear path; already won over a mile, so going back to that trip is fine, but still needs a bit more unless other underperform.

RaceName: Prix Daphnis - Jockey Club Argentino (Arg) (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Guy Pariente Holding, G Augustin-Normand & Ecurie Friedrider
Spotlight: Ran well in a couple of Group 1s as a 2yo, notably when second in the Criterium International (1m, very soft) in October, and run creditably this year without showing huge improvement; not beaten far as an outsider in the Prix du Jockey Club last time, which featured a few of these, and probably capable of better.

RaceName: Prix Daphnis - Jockey Club Argentino (Arg) (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Ballylinch Stud, Ecurie Euroling et al
Spotlight: Made winning debut in February and quickly developed into a smart performer at around this trip; finished ahead of Campacite in the Group 3 Prix de Guiche in May (1m1f, good to soft) before not being beaten far in the German 2000 Guineas, a race the winner and second have boosted since; open to more improvement and one of the more interesting ones in the field.

RaceName: Prix Daphnis - Jockey Club Argentino (Arg) (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Had plenty of smart performances as a juvenile, including a fine third placing in the Dewhurst, but wasn't at his best, for all that he was third, in the 2,000 Guineas on his return, albeit the first two continue to frank the form; did much better when cheekpieces went on for the Irish 2,000 under this rider, although Gstaad finished ahead of him again, and easy to like down in class.

RaceName: Prix Daphnis - Jockey Club Argentino (Arg) (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Posted some decent efforts as a 2yo and went close in a Woodbine Grade 1 (1m, firm) but not so good in 2026 and well beaten in a handicap last time; huge upturn in form required.

RaceName: Prix Daphnis - Jockey Club Argentino (Arg) (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Won both starts as a 2yo over a mile on soft ground but was well behind Komorebi in the Group 3 Prix de Fontainebleau at Longchamp (1m, good) on his seasonal return and comes into this off a fourth at Newmarket in a mile Listed race; quite possible he wants much softer going ideally, so others are preferred.

RaceName: Prix Daphnis - Jockey Club Argentino (Arg) (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Jean-Claude Seroul, Gerard Augustin-Normand & Gerard Larrieu
Spotlight: Nicely bred son of Wootton Bassett, who comes into this off a pair of mile condition race wins (taking him to 3-4), most recently at La Teste De Buch on good ground; probably capable of further improvement and looks one to note in the betting under Christophe Soumillon for first time.

RaceName: Prix Daphnis - Jockey Club Argentino (Arg) (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Started career with a 6l win at Chantilly last September (1m, good), and then beat Lord Clover over the same C&D in April on soft; not seen since losing his unbeaten status in the Poule d'Essai Des Poulains from a wide draw in cheekpieces, where he didn't beat a rival, but three-month absence suggests something could have been amiss; gone well fresh in the past, so not easily dismissed.

RaceName: Lily O'Hare Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Two course wins, over 2m6f and more recently over 2m4f in April; okay chase debut here in June and has had a break since; back hurdling and this trip looks on the short side.

RaceName: Lily O'Hare Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Dual-purpose 7yo who won C&D handicap hurdle last summer off 92; absent since November so may need this, but jockey/trainer going well and any market strength worth noting.

RaceName: Lily O'Hare Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Twice finished well in 2m1f Wexford handicaps before off the mark in similar mares' contest on Friday, showing good attitude from last to finish clear with the runner-up (good); carries mandatory 7lb penalty.

RaceName: Lily O'Hare Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Maiden over both hurdles and fences, placed twice in C&D handicap hurdles last year including second in this race off 96; handicap chase form of late below best and blinkers now added to usual tongue-tie for hurdles return.

RaceName: Lily O'Hare Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Flat winner is now 0-12 hurdling, couple of poor runs at Down Royal earlier in the year for this yard; hard to fancy.

RaceName: Lily O'Hare Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Dual AW winner is 0-6 hurdling, never counting in 2m4f Sligo handicap last month; 3lb lower but big improvement needed.

RaceName: Lily O'Hare Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Placed three times over hurdles, notably third over this trip at Sligo in June (good); didn't appear to stay 2m6f at Ballinrobe on latest, so don't rule out back in trip here.

RaceName: Lily O'Hare Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Maiden was placed on a few occasions when trained by Tony Martin; first effort of note for current yard when third of 15 over C&D last month, losing second on run-in (good) in first-time cheekpieces; tongue-tie added here.

RaceName: Lily O'Hare Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Dual-purpose maiden has yet to make an impact in handicap hurdles, hanging badly right on home turn at Wexford last time; hard to be confident in, although Danny Mullins booking a positive.

RaceName: Wasdell Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations/ EBF Restricted Fillies' Maiden (GBB/IRE Inc')
Spotlight: Showed some promise with fourth of 11, just over 4l behind Global Success, in 6f event at Newbury; has frame possibilities as things stand and an even better chance if plausible improvement materialises.

RaceName: Wasdell Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations/ EBF Restricted Fillies' Maiden (GBB/IRE Inc')
Spotlight: Placed in two novice contests at Newbury and respectable fifth, belying her 50-1 odds, in competitive nursery at Glorious Goodwood since upped to 6f; leading form contender in an ordinary maiden.

RaceName: Wasdell Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations/ EBF Restricted Fillies' Maiden (GBB/IRE Inc')
Spotlight: Flashes her tail but has broadly consistent form; creditable second in nurseries at Chepstow (6f) and Lingfield (5f) on last two starts, doing well having started slowly latest; returns to this C&D with solid claims.

RaceName: Wasdell Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations/ EBF Restricted Fillies' Maiden (GBB/IRE Inc')
Spotlight: Sister to 6f AW winner Nursia (RPR 74), out of unraced sibling to UAE 1m4f Group 2 winner Bold Act and two 2yo scorers (6f/7f); sole newcomer in the field and starts off at an ordinary level; interesting.

RaceName: Wasdell Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations/ EBF Restricted Fillies' Maiden (GBB/IRE Inc')
Spotlight: Irish filly who showed ability with running-on fifth at Bellewstown, then understandably never figured when facing a much stiffer task in Listed grade at Naas; possibilities back down in class and upped to 6f.

RaceName: Wasdell Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations/ EBF Restricted Fillies' Maiden (GBB/IRE Inc')
Spotlight: Ran according to market expectations (rank outsider of five) in 6f contest at Salisbury; drops to a slightly lower level but is perhaps one for handicaps later on.

RaceName: Wasdell Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations/ EBF Restricted Fillies' Maiden (GBB/IRE Inc')
Spotlight: Last of five in both starts, achieving very little.

RaceName: Wasdell Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations/ EBF Restricted Fillies' Maiden (GBB/IRE Inc')
Spotlight: Folded tamely and well beaten in big-field maiden at Naas (6f) won by a Ballydoyle colt who followed up in the Richmond; may do better at this lesser level and is one of two Irish raiders who add interest.

RaceName: Wasdell Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations/ EBF Restricted Fillies' Maiden (GBB/IRE Inc')
Spotlight: Ducked left at the start and always behind in 6f maiden at Newbury; may post a bigger effort at this easier-looking level with the experience under her belt; check the market signals for positive signs.

RaceName: FBD Hotels And Resorts Phoenix Sprint Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Course specialist made it ten wins here with a Listed race success over this trip in June; also won the Gladness Stakes over 7f here in March; second to subsequent Group 1 winner Comanche Brave in the Greenlands in May, with James Delight in third; holding his form admirably on the evidence of Group 2 second over 7f here three weeks ago.

RaceName: FBD Hotels And Resorts Phoenix Sprint Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Won the Sprint Cup at Haydock last season when his form also featured a fine second in the July Cup; towards the rear in this year's edition of the Newmarket showpiece last month; previously found 5f a bit sharp in the King Charles III Stakes at Royal Ascot; best treated at the weights but questions to answer.

RaceName: FBD Hotels And Resorts Phoenix Sprint Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Smart handicap form this season. also a fine third behind Big Gossey in a C&D Listed race on his penultimate start; not one of his better handicap displays on latest.

RaceName: FBD Hotels And Resorts Phoenix Sprint Stakes (Group 3)
OwnerName: AMO Racing Limited & Giselle De Aguiar
Spotlight: Former top-class juvenile, six-time winner, four at this track, including the 2023 Phoenix Stakes and this race last year; finished behind Big Gossey and James Delight when fourth in the Greenlands here in May; failed to make much impact over 5f here last time; capable of a big run on his day.

RaceName: FBD Hotels And Resorts Phoenix Sprint Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Won last year's Greenlands Stakes here, battling well to beat another British challenger, with Big Gossey a little unlucky in a close third; struggled in two Group 1s in the autumn; out of the money on seasonal debut at Doncaster in March; more like it in his repeat bid in the Greenlands, splitting Big Gossey and Bucanero Fuerte; relatively light campaign may stand to him now.

RaceName: TLC Teddies For Loving Care Handicap
Spotlight: Won at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) in April and close third at Chester (1m4f, good) four weeks ago; this 6yo could give another good account but is taking on some unexposed 3yos and may well be vulnerable.

RaceName: TLC Teddies For Loving Care Handicap
Spotlight: Inconsistent this season but caught wide when fifth at Chester last time and prior to that he was an easy winner over this C&D (good to firm); both wins have come at this venue and he's not ruled out.

RaceName: TLC Teddies For Loving Care Handicap
Spotlight: Easily justified favouritism when upped in trip on his handicap and seasonal debut at Southwell (1m4f, AW) in June; last of four at Yarmouth (1m6f, good to firm) eight days later but remains very much of interest for a trainer who excels with this type of 3yo; wears first-time cheekpieces.

RaceName: TLC Teddies For Loving Care Handicap
OwnerName: W Sweatman, J Summers, R Foden
Spotlight: Made handicap debut at Bath (11.6f, firm) last month over a new trip having been gelded and he won by 2l; that form has worked out well and he could still be ahead of the handicapper following a 7lb rise.

RaceName: TLC Teddies For Loving Care Handicap
Spotlight: He'd been knocking at the door prior to getting off the mark at the eighth attempt in a handicap at Chester (1m4f, good) a fortnight ago; did well to get up having had to be switched and he's just 2lb higher today; could have more to offer for top yard and he's in calculations.

RaceName: TLC Teddies For Loving Care Handicap
Spotlight: Won by a short head at Beverley (1m2f, good to firm) in June and followed up by a neck in first-time cheekpieces at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm); fifth of six at Nottingham (1m1f, good to firm) since but finished close up and it's possible the switch to blinkers will eke out something extra.

RaceName: ARC Prix Maurice de Gheest - Fee - En Memoire de Louis Romanet (Group 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Improved performer with a decent strike-rate; won a conditions event at twice in Listed company before posting a career-best effort in the Queen Elizabeth II Jubilee Stakes at Royal Ascot; that form has been franked, he stays further than this trip and he's a player.

RaceName: ARC Prix Maurice de Gheest - Fee - En Memoire de Louis Romanet (Group 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Given weight and a beating by Stolen Kiss at Chantilly in May but turned in his best effort when winning Group 3 event over 6f at this course last time; this demands a big step forward.

RaceName: ARC Prix Maurice de Gheest - Fee - En Memoire de Louis Romanet (Group 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Very useful sort who won conditions event on heavy at Chantilly in May; well beaten behind Mise En Boite on first run in Group company last time; makes no appeal.

RaceName: ARC Prix Maurice de Gheest - Fee - En Memoire de Louis Romanet (Group 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Consistent sort who turned in best effort when fourth to Mission Central in the King Charles III at Royal Ascot; below that at the Curragh last time and more a place prospect than a win-only one.

RaceName: ARC Prix Maurice de Gheest - Fee - En Memoire de Louis Romanet (Group 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Group 2/3 winner at Chantilly last autumn and has posted respectable efforts in the Group 1 Commonwealth Cup/Jean Prat on last two starts; cheekpieces fitted last time are on again and he's another with place claims.

RaceName: ARC Prix Maurice de Gheest - Fee - En Memoire de Louis Romanet (Group 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Has won three of his five starts, the pick being when beating Samangan in the Group 3 Djebel in April; failed to match that in a steadily run Group 2 last time but should get a better gallop to aim at and he has each-way prospects.

RaceName: ARC Prix Maurice de Gheest - Fee - En Memoire de Louis Romanet (Group 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Steadily progressive sort who turned in best effort to win Listed event over 6f at this venue last time; capable of better but big step forward needed if he's to win on first outing in Group company.

RaceName: ARC Prix Maurice de Gheest - Fee - En Memoire de Louis Romanet (Group 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Turned in a clear pb when winning last year's Middle Park but long way below that level this season and ran as though something was amiss when tailed off in the Commonwealth Cup (trainer/vet couldn't shed any light on the run); reproduction of the Middle Park form gives him prospects but the percentage call is to oppose.

RaceName: ARC Prix Maurice de Gheest - Fee - En Memoire de Louis Romanet (Group 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Has improved with every run and turned in his best effort when second to subsequent Group 1 Jean Prat winner Thesecretadversary in the Jersey at Royal Ascot; cheekpieces fitted for this slight drop in trip and may be capable of better; interesting.

RaceName: ARC Prix Maurice de Gheest - Fee - En Memoire de Louis Romanet (Group 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Yet to win at three but has stepped up a fair way on his juvenile form, with his best effort to finish a close third in the Commonwealth Cup at Royal Ascot; bit below that level but still a respectable effort in the July Cup and he should appreciate this extra distance; player.

RaceName: ARC Prix Maurice de Gheest - Fee - En Memoire de Louis Romanet (Group 1) (Turf)
OwnerName: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier
Spotlight: Matched Cheveley Park effort when winning this year's 1,000 Guineas and has run well in defeat all outings since, including in the Jean Prat over 7f here last time (in front of Samangan); slight drop in distance isn't a concern and she should run well.

RaceName: Franco Hughes Away Bet Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Likeable type was dual winning hurdler in 2024 and two chase wins last year; good third over hurdles at Killarney (2m7f) when tried in cheekpieces and has good record at this time of year.

RaceName: Franco Hughes Away Bet Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Dual bumper winner and beat Poetic Twist by a neck in Killarney maiden hurdle over a little farther than this; only 6-1 for 20-runner 2m handicap at Galway, exited at halfway.

RaceName: Franco Hughes Away Bet Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Had a good time last summer, winning on the level and over hurdles, second over 2m2f here as well; was reverting from three runs over fences when beaten 37l over 2m at Galway.

RaceName: Franco Hughes Away Bet Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won over 2m3f here last year and consistent efforts over 2m in the spring; back from a break and steps back up in trip; stays 2m4f well.

RaceName: Franco Hughes Away Bet Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Pulled up twice after maiden win here last August; after a break, was huge price when running well at Galway, staying on to be 15l seventh in 20-runner mares' handicap.

RaceName: Franco Hughes Away Bet Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Maiden winner over this trip at Tramore and closely matched with Samba Train on run before at Killarney; remote second over 2m3f at Kilbeggan, but third left that form behind when winning readily at Galway; handicap debut.

RaceName: Franco Hughes Away Bet Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: A revelation at this venue in recent months; two wins and a second from last four outings, all over this trip; up 8lb for last month's victory.

RaceName: Franco Hughes Away Bet Mares Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: Mrs T Giles-Fahey & Miss S Mangan
Spotlight: Another that goes well here with pair of C&D wins this summer; beat Gangster Granny two runs back and now meets her on 7lb better terms (including claims); beaten 3l on latest visit.

RaceName: Franco Hughes Away Bet Mares Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won over shorter trip here in October; stumbled badly in the dip when only a length off Joya Del Mar over C&D on just her second outing of the year.

RaceName: Franco Hughes Away Bet Mares Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: Sussex By The Sea Syndicate/David L'Estrange
Spotlight: Last couple of runs not her best but she's been runner-up four times in handicaps, including over C&D in March; would probably prefer easier terrain.

RaceName: Floyds Turfcar Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Proved markedly resurgent with 28-1 win at Pontefract (6f, good to firm) last time, ending a poor spell; still well treated on best 2yo figures; respected assuming he remains in form.

RaceName: Floyds Turfcar Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Eye-catcher on 2yo debut but has failed to build on that effort; trailed home last of ten, having pulled hard, at Salisbury (6f) on handicap/seasonal debut; something to prove.

RaceName: Floyds Turfcar Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Six-race maiden who has inconsistent form; posted one of his better efforts at Bath (5.7f) most recently but finished last of the five runners; not particularly solid.

RaceName: Floyds Turfcar Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Holds a fighting chance on peak form, namely success off just 1lb lower in first-time cheekpieces at Lingfield (6f, good) in May; drops back in trip after attempting 7f last time.

RaceName: Floyds Turfcar Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Still a maiden on turf but is in a consistent vein of form, close fourth at Bath (5.7f) kept to classified level last time; gained his AW handicap success off current mark; solid chance.

RaceName: Floyds Turfcar Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Campaigned over 5f since switched to handicaps, dead-heating at Chepstow the first attempt; most efforts since suggest this return to 6f is well worth exploring; major player.

RaceName: Floyds Turfcar Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Far-from-solid maiden whose chance depends on whether she's capable of backing up latest effort, namely close fourth at Carlisle (6f, soft); has weak claims on previous form.

RaceName: Floyds Turfcar Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Poor maiden over longer trips in Ireland for Tommy Dowling; chance partly depends on whether the switch to sprinting prompts improvement; declared 8.10 Lingfield Saturday.

RaceName: Keeneland Phoenix Stakes (Group 1) (No Geldings)
Spotlight: Not especially convincing when landing the odds over 5f at Naas on second start; much sharper next time over C&D when second to the subsequent Coventry winner Great Barrier Reef; beaten 7l in ninth when 5-2 favourite in the Norfolk; got up late to win a 5f Listed race at Naas; finished in the rear in the Railway Stakes won by Celeron, up against it.

RaceName: Keeneland Phoenix Stakes (Group 1) (No Geldings)
Spotlight: Refused to enter the stalls on his intended debut at Navan; made a good impression over C&D at the beginning of June; missed the break in the Windsor Castle won by King Of Cloughran; left that form far behind when beating Tribeca comprehensively in the Railway Stakes; not short of speed but looks like a type who will stay further than this.

RaceName: Keeneland Phoenix Stakes (Group 1) (No Geldings)
Spotlight: Shaped with promise over C&D in May on debut; showed the benefit of the run with an emphatic maiden over 7f at Gowran in June; split two Aidan O'Brien-trained runners when second in the Group 3 Tyros Stakes over 7f at Leopardstown; might find this a bit sharp, though the champion jockey sticks with him.

RaceName: Keeneland Phoenix Stakes (Group 1) (No Geldings)
Spotlight: Twice in the frame on home soil before bringing off a 33-1 shock in the Windsor Castle, getting up late after meeting a lot of trouble on running; did not look entirely straightforward when beaten by the sole French-trained runner in the Group 2 Prix Robert Papin at Chantilly.

RaceName: Keeneland Phoenix Stakes (Group 1) (No Geldings)
Spotlight: Listowel maiden winner or his third outing; out of his depth in the Coventry; outran his 50-1 odds when fourth in the Railway Stakes; admirable sort but held by Celeron and Tribeca.

RaceName: Keeneland Phoenix Stakes (Group 1) (No Geldings)
OwnerName: AMO Racing Limited & Mrs A O'Callaghan
Spotlight: Form of debut win at Navan has worked out; finished behind Carry The Flag in the Norfolk; beaten decisively by Celeron in the Railway Stakes and may struggle to turn the tables.

RaceName: Keeneland Phoenix Stakes (Group 1) (No Geldings)
Spotlight: Just denied on debut at Naas; impressive when beating Green Empress by 5l over C&D next time; well backed when a close second in the Albany Stakes at Royal Ascot; a snug odds-on winner of a Group 2 here only eight days later; Aidan O'Brien has won this 17 times, but only once since 2017 and never with a filly; hard to oppose all the same.

RaceName: Keeneland Phoenix Stakes (Group 1) (No Geldings)
OwnerName: Gary Matthews, Steve Weston & Lucky Hat
Spotlight: Made it 2-2 with a smooth success in a four-runner 5f Listed race here in May; faded in a 6f Group 3 at Naas next time; kept on well when eighth of 27 in the Group 2 Queen Mary at the Royal Ascot; third in a recent Group 3 at Ascot; this is demanding for a 97-rated filly.

RaceName: Dave Myers Memorial - I'm Having A Dave Day Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Promising fourth in first-time cheekpieces (retained since) at Beverley (8.4f, good to firm) last month and she showed a good attitude to beat Spiritoftheblues over this C&D (good to firm) 11 days ago; key player up 3lb.

RaceName: Dave Myers Memorial - I'm Having A Dave Day Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: 0-5, all in novice races, but she kept on for fourth at Doncaster (7f, good) two starts ago and lost all chance when hampered at Chester (7f, good) last time; she's shaped as though the step back up to 1m could be a good move and she's firmly in calculations on handicap debut.

RaceName: Dave Myers Memorial - I'm Having A Dave Day Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Won on debut at Ayr last August and runner-up in two of her three handicaps, finishing close up behind Cancelled over C&D (good to firm) 11 days ago having made the running; 3lb better off with the winner for just under 1l; trainer won this with a 3yo last year; in the mix.

RaceName: Dave Myers Memorial - I'm Having A Dave Day Fillies' Handicap
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid
Spotlight: 1l third of six at Yarmouth (1m, good to firm) in June on second handicap start and not beaten far in fifth at Lingfield (7f, good to firm) last time, when interference and possibly the drop back in trip were against her; wears first-time cheekpieces and could go well back up to 1m.

RaceName: Dave Myers Memorial - I'm Having A Dave Day Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Ran well in defeat in two handicaps in May (1m, good to firm/good) before winning a maiden at Beverley (8.4f, good) in June on her ninth start; went up the weights for that and she wasn't beaten by the trip when third of four back in a handicap at Beverley (1m2f, good to firm); improvement needed.

J Murdoch Contracts Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: British point-to-point form nothing to shout about, nor his run in an Aintree bumper; second maiden hurdle run at Kilbeggan was a small step forward, but still plenty more likely required here and tongue-tie added.

RaceName: J Murdoch Contracts Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Court Cave gelding; runner-up twice in point-to-points in season just ended, soundly beaten both times; bought for 26,000euros and never sighted on recent hurdles debut in a better-class Galway maiden; may need more time.

RaceName: J Murdoch Contracts Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Runner-up in 2m Navan handicap in late 2024 (yielding-to-soft) the nearest he's got; fair fourth in 2m4f Down Royal novice handicap following year (good) but soon beaten following month in similar Fairyhouse contest; returns from 16 months' absence.

RaceName: J Murdoch Contracts Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Placed twice in bumpers; mildly encouraging hurdles debut in 2m3f maiden here in June (good) but poor effort at Bellewstown last month; eligible for a mark after today.

RaceName: J Murdoch Contracts Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Twice ran in point-to-points before hurdles debut in May, leading to beyond halfway before dropping away; may need more time.

RaceName: J Murdoch Contracts Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Half-brother to three winners over distances from 2m3f-3m; nibbled at big odds on debut in extended 2m6f maiden at Ballinrobe in late May, coming from rear to finish 6l second; won't have to improve too much to go one better here.

RaceName: J Murdoch Contracts Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Ran okay in a bumper here and much improved on second attempt in maiden hurdles when chasing home a ready 4l winner in C&D maiden last month (good); respected.

RaceName: J Murdoch Contracts Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Half-sister to smart 2m1f-2m4f hurdler/chaser Senecia; dam 2m4f-3m hurdle/chase winner; won Rathcannon point-to-point in April (soft) and encouraging hurdles debut at Wexford when staying on into second on run-in (having hung right) over 2m4f; step up in trip should suit and one to consider.

RaceName: J Murdoch Contracts Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Tailed off in two bumpers in May and no threat on last month's hurdles debut at Cork; best watched for now.

RaceName: DragonBet Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Wolverhampton winner in May (8.6f); an eye-catching fifth at Kempton last month before another promising run from well off the pace at Windsor (1m, good to firm); could be interesting.

RaceName: DragonBet Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Has raced five times, the standout effort when beaten a neck over C&D last month; latest defeat here was at 1m2f; each-way claims.

RaceName: DragonBet Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Only 2lb higher than when fending off Ajrad and Scarfo here last month (7f) but never threatened to follow up 16 days ago, again here; however, consistent in the main and couldn't rule out.

RaceName: DragonBet Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Five-time winner who has been in good form this season and found only one too good over C&D a month ago; could have done without the 2lb nudge but should be involved; has competitive form in the reapplied tongue-tie.

RaceName: DragonBet Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: C&D winner who so nearly brought up her hat-trick at Salisbury (1m, good to firm); has another 3lb to deal with but she's on the money right now.

RaceName: DragonBet Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Good 2yo form; remains a maiden after 20 starts but he's fallen a long way in the weights and, at odds of 4-1, was a clear second over C&D 55 days ago; considered.

RaceName: DragonBet Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Hooded for all six races and now has a tongue-tie added; the drop back to 1m is slightly concerning when she finished well over 1m1f last time, but with a lightly raced profile and clearly in form, she's a likely contender.

RaceName: DragonBet Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: In a good run of form when winning this 12 months ago and returns after a close third here over 7f; nothing wrong with his mark.

RaceName: DragonBet Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: C&D winner on soft ground in June and has continued to run well, last time back over 7f and just ahead of Ajrad; another solid candidate to consider.

RaceName: DragonBet Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Has placed form but now 0-10 and had no excuses in a classified race last time.

RaceName: DragonBet Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Closely matched with A Rose Adaay on their recent clash in a classified race; probably needs more back in a handicap and he's hard to win with (2-33).

RaceName: DragonBet Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: A lightly raced 3yo but with no form claims, including two handicaps.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Handicap
Spotlight: Nine-time turf winner, including a 6f Group 3 in 2023; has also won at Listed level and was once rated 108, so has dropped a long way; good efforts over this trip and 6.5f here recently and even better at Galway last time when a close second of 15 (7f, yielding); had things in his favour that day but should remain competitive off 4lb higher.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Handicap
Spotlight: All three wins for Kieran Cotter came at Cork (6f-1m); a long way below his best in three runs for new yard this term; others preferred.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Handicap
Spotlight: Added a fifth win when a short head in front at Navan last time (6f, good), but may have benefited from his track position (runner-up on same side); up 4lb for that but has won off a high of 87 in the past and three of his wins have come at this venue (two over C&D).

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Handicap
OwnerName: John B O'Hagan & Mrs John Murphy
Spotlight: 5f Dundalk winner last season; stepped up on previous form when winning at Naas last month (5f, good), third won next time out; didn't run too badly over 5f here last time off his 5lb higher mark when a 2.75l eighth of 18 (5f, good to firm); Foley takes over from 7lb claimer now.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Handicap
Spotlight: Remained a maiden after seven starts for Owen Burrows (beaten favourite in all four handicap starts for former yard this season); purchased for 35,0000gns last month and it wasn't a bad stable debut when a 5l fourth of 11 at Naas (6f, good, 16-1) last time.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Handicap
Spotlight: Placed in several maidens last season at 6f-1m; fine return to action at Fairyhouse (6f, good) in June when a luckless fourth; didn't improve over 7f at Galway last time when a distant fourth (yielding); ran poorly in sole start at this venue in a 7f handicap last season; new headgear combination tried.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Handicap
Spotlight: Now an 18-race maiden but several good placed efforts; close second of 21 over 5f at Navan (winner won again since) in June; fast finishing fourth at Fairyhouse last month when not getting a clear run (6f, good); just 0.75l behind the winner when fourth again at Fairyhouse last time (7f, good); up 3lb more but top rider booked.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Handicap
OwnerName: Ms Yvonne Hennessy & Ms S O'Neill
Spotlight: Gained fourth win of his career at Down Royal (5f, soft) in June; followed his wins with two solid close-up fourths over 5f at Naas and here last time; mark remains unchanged but all his best efforts have been over 5f.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Handicap
Spotlight: His best maiden run came at the third attempt last season when a 3l second of 14 at Navan (6f, good); beaten 30l at Fairyhouse on seasonal return/handicap debut; close-up fourth of ten at Navan (5f, good) was much better next time; another deplorable effort at Naas last time when last of 10; blinkers on but not a trustworthy character.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Handicap
Spotlight: AW winner got off the mark on turf at Naas this time last year (6f, good to yielding) off 5lb lower; ran his best race this term when a 2l third of ten back at Naas last time (6f, good); new headgear combination tried; hasn't run too badly at this track in the past.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Handicap
Spotlight: Has raced exclusively on AW since two moderate efforts in opening maidens, including over C&D; improved form when second in a 10.5f maiden at Dundalk in January in first-time cheekpieces; they didn't have the same effect over the same trip in a handicap next time; others more likely.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Handicap
Spotlight: Four wins have all been on fast tracks, including last year at Bellewstown (twice) and Down Royal over 5f; standout run this term at former venue when third (5f, soft); never counted in two most recent runs at Navan over 6f; opposable.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Handicap
Spotlight: 1m AW winner off 12lb lower has run poorly in all six starts on turf; back on the level after some moderate efforts over hurdles; unlikely.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Handicap
Spotlight: Has been keen in all three of her maidens over 7f but has shown signs of promise all the same; drops to 6f for her handicap debut now which may help; not totally ruled out.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Handicap
Spotlight: Three-time winner over 6f on yielding and good ground; just fair efforts in her opening three runs this term before going down by a neck at Cork last time (6f, good to firm) under today's rider; she's 1lb wrong despite a 4lb rise for the last day, but has won from a higher mark in the past.

RaceName: ADS Handicap
Spotlight: Impressive at Lingfield (6f, AW) last November on sole 2yo start and runner-up to very talented sprinter there (6f novice, good) in May; merely sixth on recent handicap debut at Chester (6f, good) but he's better than that and it will be no surprise if he's a force today; a tongue-tie goes on.

RaceName: ADS Handicap
Spotlight: Unplaced in both nurseries but reappeared at Chester (6f, good) last month having been gelded and showed improved form in second of six, coming clear of the third; high on the list after that performance.

RaceName: ADS Handicap
Spotlight: Well beaten in a big field at York (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago and something to prove after that, but he was second of 14 over the same C&D (good) in June and is not written off.

RaceName: ADS Handicap
Spotlight: Won Newbury maiden (6f, good to firm) in June on third start and made it 2-2 for the year in handicap at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) later that month; down the field at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) since but it was a difficult race in which to make inroads from the rear; retains potential.

RaceName: ADS Handicap
Spotlight: Won 2yo maiden at Ayr last April on second start but beaten a long way at big odds in handicaps on his two starts this year.

RaceName: ADS Handicap
Spotlight: Comfortably made all in first-time cheekpieces (retained since) on handicap debut here (5f, good) in June; however, only sixth of eight at Newmarket (5f, good to firm) since and has to leave that run well behind.

Join Us For Ladies Day Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: First, third and second in three C&D handicaps last year; good return to action in June when third to Joya Del Mar over C&D and touched off over 3m at Wexford last month; little to dislike.

RaceName: Join Us For Ladies Day Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Nice pedigree and shrewd owners; first time to be a single-figure price when second to subsequent winner at Clonmel where he was staying on over 2m3f; probably wants to go this way, so given a pass for Killarney sixth.

RaceName: Join Us For Ladies Day Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Consistent over hurdles last year, gaining sole win over extended 2m4f at Wexford; chasing this summer, second over farther here in in May and good run at Kilbeggan last time; cheekpieces return.

RaceName: Join Us For Ladies Day Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Winning miler has been around the houses; best run in three handicap hurdle starts was 6l fifth at Wexford on stable debut; not as good twice since and query over his stamina for this far.

RaceName: Join Us For Ladies Day Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Point winner had some okay handicap runs, when hooded and fairly well fancied, for Peter Fahey last year; best effort was fourth of 18 over 2m4f at Listowel festival; two poor runs over 3m this year, including last month's stable debut (only 11-2, no headgear); hood back on and tongue-tie added.

RaceName: Join Us For Ladies Day Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: One of three for the 'Shark'; three handicap starts, lapped either of side of well-ridden 7-1 Limerick second (rider went wide for drier ground); hard to know.

RaceName: Join Us For Ladies Day Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a couple of points for Sean Doyle and pair of okay runs in Wexford handicaps last year for Richie Rath; tailed off at Cork last month; stable debut.

RaceName: Join Us For Ladies Day Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: Something Simple Syndicate/J C Hurley Et Al
Spotlight: Bumper form was okay; little of note hurdling until Limerick fourth in May (2m6f, soft); weakened over 3m latest; headgear and top jockey.

RaceName: Join Us For Ladies Day Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Homebred filly by Golden Lariat; beaten 30l on debut and twice tailed off since; first handicap.

RaceName: Join Us For Ladies Day Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Sole win was off 84 in 2024 edition of this; just one placed effort in 11 starts since; not a bad run under King last time when beaten 11l over this trip at Ballinrobe.

RaceName: Capital Windscreens Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Retains plenty of vitality aged eight but completed his May/June four-timer in Class 6 and was soundly beaten when back up in grade last time; current mark leaves him in a difficult spot.

RaceName: Capital Windscreens Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
OwnerName: The Soldiers Of Fortune Iv & Partner
Spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden whose form for current yard comprises two dismal efforts over hurdles and a modest third of four in 1m2f novice event at Doncaster; however, may improve now handicapping.

RaceName: Capital Windscreens Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Five-race maiden who has shown positive signs in her two handicap attempts, keeping-on third upped to 1m2f at Sandown (good to firm) latest; progress still looks possible; enters calculations.

RaceName: Capital Windscreens Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Prevailed by 1l in C&D contest (good to firm) last month on only his fourth start for current yard; back up only 3lb he remains attractively handicapped on 3yo form; respected.

RaceName: Capital Windscreens Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Had a prolonged consistent spell until showing a dip in his form this spring/summer; well treated if getting back to his peak but others are preferred on recent evidence.

RaceName: Capital Windscreens Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
Spotlight: Veteran who completed a quickfire double last autumn but is 0-13 since and his second-place finish in June has not been backed up, kept to Brighton since; opposed.

RaceName: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
Spotlight: Last win came in a valuable C&D handicap in June 2024 off 88; best run for almost a year came in the same event here last time in first-time blinkers (retained), with 3l back to Playin Cool; 5lb rise for that is perhaps a tad harsh but winner ran well twice at Galway; firmly in the mix.

RaceName: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
Spotlight: Ended a long losing sequence with a 10.5f Cork win in April under this rider (good to yielding) off 3lb lower; didn't appreciate drop back to 7f back at Cork the following month (short head behind Dark Viper); never better than midfield over this trip at Naas when last seen; others preferred.

RaceName: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
Spotlight: Dual handicap winner over 7f this year; struggled when sent into premier handicap company over 6.5f here last time (good to firm); this trip not sure to suit and she looks up against it.

RaceName: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
Spotlight: 1-8, with the win coming in a heavy ground 1m1f Leopardstown maiden in October; went close over 7f in a handicap back there in June and was a decent third off this mark over C&D next time (3l behind Booyea); showed signs of delayed recovery post-race at Leopardstown last time when finishing last of 11; needs to bounce back.

RaceName: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
Spotlight: All three wins have come at Leopardstown, including last time over 1m1f (good) when a comfortable victor after being allowed to dictate the pace; 5lb rise for that seems fair enough and he's in good form but must win away from his preferred track.

RaceName: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
OwnerName: Just The Two Of Us Partnership
Spotlight: Last of five wins was in 2023; not the force he was, though has run well at times; fair third of eight in a Killarney handicap last month but well beaten in a premier Galway handicap last time (1m1f, yielding); others preferred.

RaceName: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
OwnerName: Nigel O'Hare & Martin W White & Mark Devlin & C G Bryson
Spotlight: In fine form this year; AW winner in February has raced three times at this track, winning twice over 7f and finishing second once over C&D; up 5lb for her latest win here last time (7f, good) under today's rider; could post another bold bid.

RaceName: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan
Spotlight: Off the mark at the sixth attempt in maiden company at Killarney last time (1m, good), his second run since being gelded; raced keenly that day but kept on well to win; not ruled out on his handicap debut.

RaceName: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
Spotlight: Added to her Ballinrobe maiden win over an extended 1m1f trip when landing a 1m2f Leopardstown handicap by a neck last time (good); she was probably value for more than the winning distance that day and should be competitive off just 3lb higher but the drop to 1m is a slight negative.

RaceName: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
OwnerName: B White & M W White & D Sheridan & Ms H McGuinness
Spotlight: One of two for trainer; up 10lb compared to his Leopardstown win in June (7f, good); ran with credit off his revised mark at Galway last time when fourth of 15 (7f, yielding); upped to 1m now and should give a good account of himself again.

RaceName: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
Spotlight: One of two for trainer; all three wins have come here, including one over C&D; 8lb below his last winning mark from 2024; good placed form on good ground over 1m here in June and at Killarney and Gowran last month; yielding to soft ground a possible excuse when disappointing at Galway last time; he could have a big run in him with Keane aboard for the first time.

RaceName: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
Spotlight: Rarely runs a bad race; won a 7f maiden at Dundalk in March; some decent runs in defeat on turf since; second in a five-runner conditions race at Leopardstown over this trip in June and took the third spot at Killarney in a handicap off this mark next time; fifth of sixth but only 2.75l away from the winner over C&D last time; 1lb wrong but should run her race.

RaceName: Leicestershire And Rutland Freemasons Charity LRFC Handicap
Spotlight: Won two in a row at Redcar (1m1f/1m, good to firm) last month and completed hat-trick at Hamilton (1m1f, good) last Saturday; he's 6lb higher than last time and has never won over this far, but he's finished strongly for his recent wins and there's still plenty of mileage in his mark on old form.

RaceName: Leicestershire And Rutland Freemasons Charity LRFC Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win (from 15 attempts) came here last July (1m4f, good); went very close behind Clipsham Noble over this C&D (good to firm) last month on his second start of the season; Leicester brings out the best in him and he has solid claims.

RaceName: Leicestershire And Rutland Freemasons Charity LRFC Handicap
Spotlight: Some good runs in defeat this year, including here; however, only fourth of six behind Clipsham Noble over C&D (good to firm) last time and he's 0-16 since winning his first two starts in winter 2024/25; first-time blinkers replace the visor.

RaceName: Leicestershire And Rutland Freemasons Charity LRFC Handicap
OwnerName: Paul K Spencer And Mrs R Carr
Spotlight: Close third over C&D (good to firm) early last month and that performance puts him in the mix, but he's been inconsistent this year and was only fifth of six behind Clipsham Noble over C&D (good to firm) last time; the cheekpieces adopted on that latest start are left off.

RaceName: Leicestershire And Rutland Freemasons Charity LRFC Handicap
Spotlight: Won here (1m4f, good to firm) in May and he returned to form with a win over this C&D (good to firm) last month, with three of these behind; he's just 2lb higher today and could play another leading role.

RaceName: Leicestershire And Rutland Freemasons Charity LRFC Handicap
Spotlight: Showed spark when third at 40-1 at Wolverhampton (9.4f, AW) in February for Tom Ward but well beaten in May on final two runs for that yard; a major turnaround is needed on stable debut (remains in same ownership).

RaceName: Alan Dunlop, 90th Birthday INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Belated debut for Green Moon gelding; dam maiden pointer, sister to 2m5f chase winner Melua Maid; yard doesn't win bumpers.

RaceName: Alan Dunlop, 90th Birthday INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Fair level of form in five starts; best runs were debut fourth at Fairyhouse and 2m4f second (first-time cheekpieces) at Listowel in June; beaten 16l over 2m2f at Galway last time, but that was a good race.

RaceName: Alan Dunlop, 90th Birthday INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Not wild prices when beaten 6.75l both starts; pushed wide home turn at Ballinrobe last time before keeping on in fair-looking contest; another 3f to travel here.

RaceName: Alan Dunlop, 90th Birthday INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Vadamos gelding cost £22,000 as 3yo; half-brother to winners The Four Sixes (useful 2m-2m5f hurdle/chase), Innovated (2m hurdle/2m4f chase), King Of Strings (bumper/2m hurdle), Cobra Angel (3m hurdle) and Flemencello (bumper); dam 2m hurdle winner; 7-2 and 5s when pulled up in both points last year for Cormac Doyle; no surprise if he's competitive.

RaceName: Alan Dunlop, 90th Birthday INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Homebred Doctor Dino filly from good French family, dam won over 1m6f; 6-4 fav, pushed along 4f out before sticking to her task when third in 2m2f mares' bumper here in May; not much of note behind her, but winner showed the form in a good light next time.

RaceName: Alan Dunlop, 90th Birthday INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Vadamos filly from useful staying family; 25s, going nowhere 4f out on debut over C&D, and then ran green, before staying on well up the hill to be beaten around 6l behind the two market principals; owner's daughter rides again.
